pages.title: The Den Kit Company – The Flower Press | Freddie & Millie Toys
pages.ld_description: Preserving flowers by pressing is an age-old art, and one that deserves to be celebrated and cherished by every generation. Our hand-crafted, wooden flower press enables a simple way for children to enjoy this absorbing and mindful activity, whilst preserving natural beauty for use in craft projects and study.
